title: SupernovaSMP
description: Modpack adding cars, fishing revamps, QOL and roleplay possibilities. Made for SupernovaSMP
body:
Modpack for the SupernovaSMP, including a collection of QOL, transportation, and revamps!

We have a fishing revamp using the mods Hybrid Aquatic and Tide 2, allowing for a flexible and entertaining fishing experience!

We also have sleds, cars, boats, and airplanes for unique, engaging transportation in civilization-esque worlds.

Origins is another addition that offers more engaging roleplay options, as unique characters in fiction are hard to write about, given the limits of human powers, after all!
